Comfy n clean old quarter Hanoi hotel
Jun 2026 • Friends
We stayed 6 nights in total. Rooms were clean and comfortable enough. Location in the old quarter made sightseeing on foot easy. Typical Asian streets full of small eateries, coffee, souvenirs & more.
Recommend rickshaw ride for an immersing tour.
The hotel tour guide, (Tom) gives exceptional service with regional day tour suggestions. All staff super friendly and willing to help with any issues.
